independent_controls.method: Independent integer Hamming checks of two README examples and scalar partial-byte packing model; NOT original PHP execution.

conclusions: All four strategies, hash representation, analyzers, providers and tests fully read. Static small-size constructor/minimum-bit mismatch and bit-roundtrip test gap retained from incremental reviews; no PHP execution confirmation.

README distance examples3and35 independently correct. Partial-byte packing model demonstrates why original bit count cannot be reconstructed from bytes alone; not claimed ordinary64bit strategy failure.
RgbArrayAnalyzer converts channels to integers; actual alpha range and color conversion depend on Intervention Image4 driver and were not inspected here. No equivalent ICC/EXIF/alpha policy inferred.

Test providers cover GD and Imagick with six strategy configurations, plus four fixed mountain-day signatures. Block default16 differs from distance-provider Block8; finite fixtures do not establish all recipes or image quality.
Six original JPEGs visually inspected: mountain day/night, tropical high/low-resolution/crop/watermark. Support SVG rendered with macOS Quick Look and viewed.

composer.json requires PHP^8.3 and intervention/image^4; composer.lock ignored. CI uses composer update and clones Imagick master despite declaring an unused imagick matrix version. Actual resolved runtime not frozen by repository.
Root MIT fully read. No production code adopted.
limits: No PHP executable on current PATH; no PHPUnit, GD/Imagick/GMP, image hash or full runtime/performance validation performed.
